text:
sasha: FYI collecting artifacts for the eu rotator cert push. need to know if any services fell back to TLS1.2 during the window. customers asking for TLS1.3-only.
omar: during the rollout I saw a cluster of `tls: handshake failure` events from edge-proxy and a few `KMS: AccessDeniedException` and `decrypt denies` logs. putting snippets here.
sasha: paste snippets?
omar: sure:
```
2026-03-19T03:12:21Z edge-proxy-4 logs: tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: unsupported protocol
2026-03-19T03:12:21Z edge-proxy-4 logs: negotiated protocol: TLSv1.2
2026-03-19T03:12:22Z edge-proxy-11 logs: acme: cert chain contains expired intermediate
2026-03-19T03:12:25Z rotator-01 logs: KMS Error: AccessDeniedException: decrypt denies for arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123:key/rotator-eu
```
jin: I correlated that with the canary deploy timeline. looks like the rotator SA in `canary` never had the new rolebinding after the RBAC cleanup last week.
sasha: so RBAC change caused KMS to fail, rotator skipped some hosts, proxies fell back to older certs or older cipher suites?
omar: yep. rotator skipped rotation of a few intermediates. some proxies continued advertising TLS1.2 because our OpenSSL build on older ingress images doesn't support TLS1.3 correctly.
marie: quick vuln triage: the old ingress images still have openssl 1.1.1 with limited TLS1.3 support. flagged as P2. recommend image bump + rebuild.
security-bot: [automated] KMS permission denied alert: key=alias/rotator-eu attempts=9 window=12m severity=medium
sasha: action items I propose:
- jin: patch canary rotator-sa rolebinding to include `kms:Decrypt` on alias/rotator-eu and roll canary
- omar: design a short-term rotator fallback (retry using cached wrapping key + exponential backoff) and a proxy cache flush play
- marie: add structured audit events from rotator to our audit-log topic for skipped hosts and decisions
- sasha: run cross-region handshake sweep after fixes and report findings
jin: I'll own canary + EU patching and sweep for EU regions. will open PR for rolebinding change and post link.
omar: I'll prototype fallback retry in rotator: if KMS decrypt fails, attempt cached symmetric unwrap with a 5m TTL, then retry KMS decrypt in background. also will craft proxy cache flush command and a rolling restart job.
marie: working on audit events PR now. suggested minimal schema: `{ "host":"string", "action":"rotate|skip", "reason":"cipher-mismatch|kms-denied|expired-intermediate", "rotator_version":"vX.Y" }` will ship to kafka topic `audit-rotations` and CloudTrail correlation id attached.
sasha: any objections to also adding a temporary permissive role with limited scope to stop hard failures while we patch definitions? we can revoke once sweep is clean.
omar: temporary rolebinding okay but scope must be strictly alias/rotator-eu and limited to decrypt only. add an expiry annotation so it auto-removes.
jin: agree. will add `rbac.k8s.io/auto-expire-ts` annotation to the rolebinding and make it 2 hours.
marie: also suggest adding a probe that attempts TLS handshake with forced TLS1.3 and TLS1.2 across all frontends and backend mutual TLS endpoints. we should log negotiated protocol per-host.
sasha: good. I'll schedule sweep 30m after rolebinding patch. volunteers for sweep run?
jin: I will run the EU sweep and post results back here.
omar: I'll coordinate cache flush play and monitor logs for any `unsupported protocol` spikes.
marie: PR up in 10. will include example logs and sample Kibana queries to find skipped-host events.
sasha: timeline: patch in 10m, temp rolebinding + rotator fallback in 20m, cache flush plan 25m, sweep at +30m, report at +2h. thanks all :thumbsup:
